_readme: Newest first. kind: research | industry. `workstreams` are optional sub-sections; `project` links a workstream to a slug in projects.json.

roles.title: Doctoral Researcher, AI and Computer Vision

bullets: Fine-tuned a COCO-pretrained YOLOv11s detector on a custom production-line dataset, reaching 99.76% mAP@50, 100% precision, and 99.6% recall on held-out test images.
Deployed the detector with SORT tracking on four live cameras to drive a six-axis robot arm, at 212 ms mean perception latency.
Validated the deployed system in four independent end-to-end tests: 190 of 213 objects (89.2%) completed the full detect, route, and pick-and-place cycle.
Built a 54.1-million-sample video benchmark and compared five model variants over three seeds against tuned statistical baselines, with paired significance tests.
Calibrated alarm thresholds with conformal prediction, holding false-alarm rates to 3–9% against a 5% target on held-out data.
Designed a hard-example masking method for video world models that cut 32-step rollout error (RMSE) by 33–48% against the C-JEPA baseline.

items.org_full: Bangladesh Japan Information and Technology Limited
bullets: Promoted twice, from Software Engineer to Principal Software Engineer; named Best Senior Engineer of the Year in 2022.
Developed enterprise applications, integration systems, and secure APIs for technical business workflows.

workstreams.title: Retrieval-Augmented Knowledge System (RAG)
bullets: Built a document-processing and retrieval-augmented generation pipeline in Python with PyMuPDF and GPT-4o.
Enabled engineers to query specialised technical knowledge directly from enterprise PDF documentation.

workstreams.title: Secure Document Watermarking API
bullets: Delivered a REST-based PDF watermarking service in Java/Spring Boot with batch processing.
Secured the service with OAuth2/JWT authentication and HashiCorp Vault secrets management.
Set up deployment and operational monitoring with Grafana and Prometheus.

workstreams.title: Enterprise PLM/PDM System Integrations
bullets: Implemented components for Dassault Systèmes ENOVIA / 3DEXPERIENCE product-data workflows and software integrations.
Carried out data exchange and migration between PLM/PDM systems.
Modernised web-based workflows with TVC-framework frontend enhancements.
